data.name: Aura of Life
data.description: You gain a +4 morale bonus on saves against attacks that grant negative levels and saves to overcome negative levels. Each ally within 10 feet of you gains a +2 morale bonus on these saves. This ability functions only while you are conscious, not if you are unconscious or dead.
